policy.latency_source: client-side wall clock, steady-state median of back-to-back measured requests after warmup; server-side timers kept only as per-framework diagnostics
policy.selection: best lossless profile per case for the hardware this ran on (see each row's profile; configs/benchmark/SELECTED.md lists what the harness selects)
policy.cache: no response cache, no Cache-DiT, no quantized checkpoints
policy.torch_compile: ON for the competitors; sglang runs compile-off by policy (its fused kernels match or beat compiler fusion, measured)
policy.attention: each framework runs its fastest exact-precision attention; no quantized or approximate substitution
policy.version_policy: latest-vs-latest: sglang runs origin/main HEAD, every competitor runs its newest main/release line (no pinned snapshots)
policy.sglang: per-cell trees: main 1e894eb92d plus this round's fix/perf PRs, all merged into main by 2026-10-29 except sgl-project/sglang#46100 (Qwen image cells); FastH3 ran main 82f7249ce6. Exact trees per cell in reports/round-20261022/manifest.json. A rerun of the sglang column on one main commit will replace these rows.
policy.harness: round-20261022: 320a118 matrix pass, 850052a and bcb659a reruns, 72bdb18 encode-aligned video pass
policy.video_encode: every configurable framework encodes the MP4 like its closest competitor; TRT-LLM and LightX2V hard-code x264 medium/CRF 23
policy.coverage: LTX-2 and LTX-2.3 retire after this round and keep their rows; LTX-2.5 is not in this publish; FastH3 was not re-measured after the matrix pass

summary.note: Steady-state single-request latency on 4x NVIDIA B300 SXM6 AC 275GB, best lossless config per framework. SGLang-Diffusion fastest in 16/16 comparable cases across 16 cases. Throughput is reported separately.

rows.case: FLUX.3 Image Klein Base T2I · 2 GPUs

vllm-omni.reason: No FLUX.3 pipeline on vLLM-Omni main (2026-10-16). It is in the open, approved PR vllm-project/vllm-omni#9007; reclassify once it merges. Measured pre-merge on 2xH200 2026-10-16 at head 389a02a149ce with vllm==0.31.0 (the head's docker/Dockerfile.ci): CFG parallel 2 4.534 s, one GPU 9.101 s (regional compile, FLASH_ATTN). Its FLUX.3 loader reads only a local package directory (model_path = the snapshot dir), and requests need --served-model-name set to the case model.

lightx2v.reason: LightX2V main has no FLUX.3 serving path (2026-10-15): no flux3 / flux-3-image code or PR in ModelTC/LightX2V; its FLUX coverage ends at FLUX.2.

trtllm-visual.reason: No FLUX.3 pipeline on TensorRT-LLM main (2026-10-16); NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM#20430 adds it and is still a draft.

fastvideo.reason: FastVideo main has no FLUX.3 pipeline (2026-10-15): no flux3 code in hao-ai-lab/FastVideo.

trtllm-visual.reason: TensorRT-LLM VisualGen carries a Qwen-Image pipeline (tensorrt_llm/_torch/visual_gen/models/qwen_image/) but nothing for the 2.1 architecture: a code search for QwenImage21 / Qwen-Image-2.1 over NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM returns no hits, and the model is absent from pipeline_registry.py. Qwen-Image-2.1 is a distinct architecture (QwenImage21Pipeline / QwenImage21Transformer2DModel / AutoencoderKLQwenImage21 / Qwen3-VL encoder), so the existing Qwen-Image pipeline does not cover it.

fastvideo.reason: No Qwen-Image pipeline in FastVideo main (2b164405c3d1, 2026-10-07).

lightx2v.reason: No validated two-GPU LightX2V command for Qwen-Image-2.1 yet (its upstream configs for this model are single-GPU) (2026-10-10).

trtllm-visual.reason: TensorRT-LLM VisualGen carries a Qwen-Image pipeline (tensorrt_llm/_torch/visual_gen/models/qwen_image/) but nothing for the 2.1 architecture: a code search for QwenImage21 / Qwen-Image-2.1 over NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM returns no hits, and the model is absent from pipeline_registry.py. Qwen-Image-2.1 is a distinct architecture (QwenImage21Pipeline / QwenImage21Transformer2DModel / AutoencoderKLQwenImage21 / Qwen3-VL encoder), so the existing Qwen-Image pipeline does not cover it.

comfyui.reason: ComfyUI's only multi-GPU path splits CFG branches, and this case runs without CFG, so a two-GPU cell would be its one-GPU cell.

fastvideo.reason: No Qwen-Image pipeline in FastVideo main (2b164405c3d1, 2026-10-07).

lightx2v.reason: LightX2V's Qwen-Image-2.1 integration is validated in this harness for t2i only (lightx2v_task t2i); its image-conditioned path has no validated profile yet (2026-10-10).

trtllm-visual.reason: TensorRT-LLM VisualGen carries a Qwen-Image pipeline (tensorrt_llm/_torch/visual_gen/models/qwen_image/) but nothing for the 2.1 architecture: a code search for QwenImage21 / Qwen-Image-2.1 over NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM returns no hits, and the model is absent from pipeline_registry.py. Qwen-Image-2.1 is a distinct architecture (QwenImage21Pipeline / QwenImage21Transformer2DModel / AutoencoderKLQwenImage21 / Qwen3-VL encoder), so the existing Qwen-Image pipeline does not cover it.

comfyui.reason: The harness's Qwen-Image-2.1 graph is the official t2i template; an edit graph wiring the reference into its images.image_1 input has not been built and validated yet (2026-10-10).

fastvideo.reason: No Qwen-Image pipeline in FastVideo main (2b164405c3d1, 2026-10-07).

trtllm-visual.reason: Not yet classified. Confirm framework support and add a validated command profile, or mark unsupported.

fastvideo.reason: FastVideo main (2b164405c3d1, 2026-10-07) registers Z-Image-Turbo, but this harness integrates FastVideo for MiniMax-H3 only (2026-10-08); no command validated.

vllm-omni.reason: Latest vLLM-Omni has no Ideogram-4 serving path (image-gen coverage is FLUX/Qwen-Image/Wan).

lightx2v.reason: Latest LightX2V has no Ideogram-4 serving path.

trtllm-visual.reason: Latest TensorRT-LLM VisualGen has no Ideogram-4 serving path (coverage is FLUX/Wan/LTX-2/Qwen-Image/Cosmos3).

fastvideo.reason: No Ideogram pipeline in FastVideo main (2b164405c3d1, 2026-10-07).

FastVideo main (2b164405c3d1, 2026-10-07) registers Wan2.2-T2V-A14B (examples/serving/openai_wan22_t2v_a14b.yaml), but this harness integrates FastVideo for MiniMax-H3 only (2026-10-08); no command validated.

lightx2v.reason: LightX2V 19c19614's cosmos3 runner answers /v1/tasks/image/sync with HTTP 500 'Image inference did not return in-memory PNG bytes (result_png)' (4xB300, 2026-10-23): its T2I task does not populate the sync endpoint's in-memory PNG.

comfyui.reason: ComfyUI core has no Cosmos3: comfy/ldm/cosmos covers Cosmos Predict1 and Predict2 only (CosmosT2V/I2V, CosmosT2IPredict2/I2VPredict2 in comfy/supported_models.py) at master 88ab4a06, 2026-09-25.

fastvideo.reason: FastVideo main (2b164405c3d1, 2026-10-07) has Cosmos Predict2/2.5 and GEN3C pipelines but no Cosmos3.

comfyui.reason: ComfyUI core has no Cosmos3: comfy/ldm/cosmos covers Cosmos Predict1 and Predict2 only (CosmosT2V/I2V, CosmosT2IPredict2/I2VPredict2 in comfy/supported_models.py) at master 88ab4a06, 2026-09-25.

fastvideo.reason: FastVideo main (2b164405c3d1, 2026-10-07) has Cosmos Predict2/2.5 and GEN3C pipelines but no Cosmos3.

comfyui.reason: ComfyUI core has no Cosmos3: comfy/ldm/cosmos covers Cosmos Predict1 and Predict2 only (CosmosT2V/I2V, CosmosT2IPredict2/I2VPredict2 in comfy/supported_models.py) at master 88ab4a06, 2026-09-25.

fastvideo.reason: FastVideo main (2b164405c3d1, 2026-10-07) has Cosmos Predict2/2.5 and GEN3C pipelines but no Cosmos3.

comfyui.reason: ComfyUI has no sequence or tensor parallelism (its one multi-GPU path splits CFG branches, and H3 runs without CFG), so a four-GPU cell would be its one-GPU number; that number is in minimax_h3_t2va_5s.

lightx2v.reason: Checked 2026-10-08 against LightX2V main 0c2edc12 (2026-10-05): LightX2V cannot serve this checkpoint under its trained contract (fastvideo_inference.json). V2 is trained for VIDEO_SPARSE_ATTN_H3 at 0.8 sparsity on 64-token tiles, and LightX2V has no VSA backend (its sparse attentions -- Sparge, SVG, radial, NBHD, Sol-Attn, sparse Sage/FA4 -- are other methods; dense attention would run a different model). Its H3 scheduler builds only a uniform shifted grid from infer_steps, so the explicit rungs [999, 874, ..., 125] cannot be given (an 8-step grid starts at 1000). LightX2V's own few-step H3 paths (configs/minimax_h3/dmd/: 4- and 8-step LoRAs on the base checkpoint, mostly FP8/INT8) are a different distillation, not this checkpoint, and are not substituted.

trtllm-visual.reason: trtllm-visual's tracked scope in this harness is image cases; H3 is a video+audio model.

comfyui.reason: Comfy-Org/workflow_templates templates/video_fastvideo_fasth3_t2v.json exists (since 2026-09-22), but it runs int8 dense attention and VSA keeping 10% of tiles from step 0.2 -- a different numeric class and a different sparsity from the case's BF16 VSA at the trained 80% (64-token tiles). Re-checked 2026-10-22.

lightx2v.reason: LightX2V cannot run the official LTX-2 two-stage workload (dev model for stage 1, distilled LoRA for the 3-step stage-2 refine): its runner loads one transformer and merges lora_configs into it at load, and the use_upsampler path reuses that same transformer for stage 2 (lightx2v/models/runners/ltx2/ltx2_runner.py at 19c19614). The profile it had did not enable the upsampler at all, so every earlier LightX2V row ran ONE stage at the full 768x512 for 40 steps -- a heavier workload than the other rows, never comparable. Audited 2026-10-22.

fastvideo.reason: FastVideo main (2b164405c3d1, 2026-10-07) registers LTX-2, but this harness integrates FastVideo for MiniMax-H3 only (2026-10-08); no command validated.

lightx2v.reason: LightX2V cannot run the official LTX-2.3 two-stage workload: one transformer serves both stages with any LoRA merged at load (ltx2_runner.py at 19c19614), and the profile it had never enabled the upsampler, so every earlier row was one stage at the full 768x512 -- heavier than sglang's two-stage, never comparable. Audited 2026-10-22.

trtllm-visual.reason: TensorRT-LLM 1.4.0rc1 has no LTX-2.3: LTX2Pipeline lists only Lightricks/LTX-2 (19B), and '2.3' appears in no hf_id, config, test or supported-models table (checked 2026-10-22).

comfyui.reason: ComfyUI loads LTX-2.3, but no official workflow reproduces this case: sglang runs LTX-2.3's multimodal guidance in stage 1 (video CFG 3 + STG 1.0 on block 28 + modality 3, audio CFG 7 + STG + modality -- up to four DiT passes per step, LTX23SamplingParams), while ComfyUI's LTX-2.3 T2V template (and the LTX-2.5 one) is the distilled-LoRA fast path at cfg 1. A graph built from LTXVSpatioTemporalGuidance / LTXVModalityGuidance / LTXVDualCFGGuider could match it but has no upstream reference and is not validated.

fastvideo.reason: FastVideo main (2b164405c3d1, 2026-10-07) registers LTX-2.3, but this harness integrates FastVideo for MiniMax-H3 only (2026-10-08); no command validated.
